item.description:
### Fixes
- **Try Again shares the way you chose.** If a share failed, Try Again could make a different kind of link: with your own domain connected, a failed public trycloudflare.com link came back as the site's address on your domain. It now retries with the same choice. - **Firewall apps.** When a share can't get a link, the message now says that a firewall app such as Little Snitch may need to allow cloudflared to connect.
Still made for **Patchy 1.5.1**.

### New
- **Your own Total CMS defaults.** Settings › General has a new **New Total CMS sites start with** section: pick the layout, starter, frontend tools and whether templates are kept in Git, and New Site starts with your choices. You can still change them for each site. - **Keep templates in Git** is now off by default.
Still made for **Patchy 1.5.1**.

### Fixes
- Clicking a site in the sidebar no longer scrolls the list to put that site in the middle. The list still brings a site into view when you open it from the menu bar or add a new one.
Still made for **Patchy 1.5.1**.
